Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meera - 10 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Anjali - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Meera and Anjali stand near him.]

Rohan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Rohan folds his hands and prays.]

Rohan (softly): "Exactly right."

[Rohan lights a diya.]

Anjali: "I knew it!"

[Meera draws a rangoli at the door.]

Meera (surprised): "What next?"

[Rohan paints a picture.]

Rohan: "Meera, are you okay?"

[Rohan draws a picture of the house.]

Rohan: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Rohan stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Rohan: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan opens his umbrella.]

Rohan (happily): "This is amazing!"

[The rain stops.]

Anjali (excited): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Rohan stands by the road. Anjali and Meera stand near him.]

Meera: "Mom, look over here."

[Rohan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Anjali: "That was fun!"

[Rohan gets into the car.]

Rohan: "Let's see."

[Rohan gets on the bus.]

Meera: "I'm ready!"

[Rohan gets off the school bus.]

Meera: "One more time!"

[Rohan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Meera: "What a day to remember!"
